status: post hoc: designed after v5 stage A (Q5.1 MIXED: validation-selected a recovers R 0.72 / 0.41 / 0.81 / 0.96 in the 4 analysis cells, while the best fixed a recovers 0.86-1.03) and before v5 stage B finished. Frozen before any v6 run. It does not test whether meta-learning is unnecessary (one scalar is taken from the learned Sigma); it tests whether the learned Sigma's shape is the one-step residual-moment shape predicted by paper/derivations/qdf_meta_gradient.md on new datasets, separating shape from the choice of a.

questions.Q6.0: Sanity: does re-injecting the learned Sigma of the v5 QDF run into the paired SIGMA_I command reproduce the QDF test MSE (pipeline check)?
questions.Q6.1: Given the learned Sigma's trace, does I + c*S0 recover the QDF gain?
questions.Q6.2: Given the learned Sigma's trace, does the derivation's one-step shape I + c*(S0 + Diag S0) recover the QDF gain, and is it closer to the learned Sigma than I + c*S0?

platform: same as protocol_v5.json (AutoDL RTX 4080 SUPER, same software, same memory-reserving scheduler)
cells_reason: the 4 v5 analysis cells (fixed by protocol_v5 rules from stage A)

arms.LEARNED: SIGMA_I command (--meta_lr 0), then Sigma = Sigma_l of runs_v5/QDF_<cell>_<seed> (fixed_sigma_patch mode learned)
arms.PLUGIN_MATCHED: Sigma = I + c*S0, c = (tr Sigma_l - T)/tr S0 (mode plugin, unchanged from v2)
arms.PLUGIN_DIAG_MATCHED: Sigma = I + c*(S0 + Diag S0), c = (tr Sigma_l - T)/(2 tr S0) (new mode plugin_diag)

comparators: QDF and SIGMA_I test MSE from results/runs_v5.jsonl (same platform, same seed)

quantities.R_X: mean g_X / mean g_QDF per cell
quantities.shape_fit: per seed cos(Sigma_l - I, S0) and cos(Sigma_l - I, S0 + Diag S0) and ||Sigma_l - Sigma_target||_F / ||Sigma_l - I||_F, recorded in sigma_target.json

Q6.0.PIPELINE_DEVIATES: otherwise (then Q6.1/Q6.2 are reported but flagged)

Q6.1.RECOVERS: R_PLUGIN_MATCHED >= 0.8 and g > 0 for 3/3 seeds in >= 3 of 4 cells

Q6.2.shape_closer: count of the 12 runs with cos(Sigma_l - I, S0 + Diag S0) > cos(Sigma_l - I, S0), descriptive

code: fixed_sigma_patch.py adds mode plugin_diag and records cos_learned_S0, cos_learned_S0diag, relfro_learned_minus_target for plugin and plugin_diag (no change to other modes); copied over the v5 version only after v5 is packed. Runner run_grid_v6.py -> results/runs_v6.jsonl, runs_v6/; summary summarize_v6.py -> results/summary_v6.json.
integrity: all runs appended to results/runs_v6.jsonl; verdicts only from summarize_v6.py; anything else post hoc labelled.
